## Analysis

Fully degenerate baseline — zero exposure across all 19 folds. This is the starting point for `ost_v62_unified` lane. Need to break degeneracy by introducing actual trading signals.

## Next Commands (3 lines)
```bash
python train.py --lane ost_v62_unified --features baseline_momentum --min_exposure 0.02 --run_id break_degen_v1
python train.py --lane ost_v62_unified --features baseline_reversion --min_exposure 0.02 --run_id break_degen_v2
python select_champion.py --lane ost_v62_unified --candidates break_degen_v1,break_degen_v2 --metric oos_mean
```

